posts.title: Will you just sit (the stillness and carving – such is destiny)
posts.description: I was going to write something sporadic. something akin to the mosaic-style pieces I see decorating my algorithm nowadays, hung like anthropological mirrors of the modern manas. Instead, I want to write about my grandma's carved, wooden chair. In the corner. Just sitting there. Made by the eroding skin of a person, completely entwined with their craft. Made with an intention, scribed by every push
